_notes: All coordinates are untrimmed source pixels of moorish_idol_a2.png (2336x1744). Left of the cut the alpha has two vertical runs: the dorsal streamer at y 55-268 and the tail fin at y 636-1359. tail.band_y_px [560,1420] keeps only the tail run in the tail layer, so the full streamer stays in the body and does not swing with the tail. Peduncle alpha column profile (alpha>128): 148 px at x=688, narrowing to 138 px at x=720-736 (y 924-1062); the anal fin's trailing tip reaches back to x=696 (y 1586+). The cut sits at x=684 (y 921-1069) so the tail ramp (674-694) ends before that tip. pivot_y is the stalk run centre, set by hand because the streamer crosses the cut column. Fin fill seeds from every flank pixel (seed min 0) because the pectoral root sits in the front black band.
